scope.description: Mapped polygons associated through existing atlas map IDs entity-morocco in the 1914 boundary snapshot. This measures the displayed mapped extent, not an official contemporary statistic or all territory claimed by the polity.

evidence.locator: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/aourednik/historical-basemaps@master/geojson/world_1914.geojson; file SHA256 a99425f9486e2243835fdc75ad7d82e6ddf3c72fcef87a63429f3313d830cf19; geometry SHA256 b909583010037e36352da4198c8185d617c9f01a939c71fbbbba22f3c486d7bb; map IDs entity-morocco
evidence.note: WGS84 ellipsoidal geodesic polygon area, holes subtracted, exact duplicate/overlap union, antimeridian longitude unwrapping, three significant digits. No geometry repair, historical ownership or official statistical assertion. Raw computed area 374734.13632714265 km2; 1 source features. pyproj 3.7.2; Shapely 2.1.2. Derived from the actual boundary snapshot, not a population statistical geography.

qualifications: Derived mapped/geometric area, not an official contemporary historical area statistic.
Approximate historical polygons; three significant digits. Holes subtracted and overlapping mapped pieces counted once.
Boundary snapshot year is the geometry observation date. No continuous territorial validity is inferred between snapshots.
